sources.title: Microsoft x64 intrinsics list
sources.readScope: x64 supported intrinsic table: _mm_set_sd and _mm_sqrt_sd signatures and SSE2 classification. Individual instruction semantics and actual emitted artifact are separate evidence.

sources.title: Intel SDM Volume 2B, order 253667-060US, September 2016
sources.readScope: SQRTSD section, PDF zero-based pages 639–640 (printed 4-638/4-639): scalar double source/destination, legacy opcode F2 0F 51/r, SSE2 requirement, operation and intrinsic equivalent. Not the whole manual.

sources.title: Intel Floating-Point Reference Sheet v2.13
sources.readScope: Both pages: double format, operation-specific square root cases, MXCSR rounding/FTZ/DAZ, infinitely precise result followed by IEEE rounding flow. Applied to audited finite SQRTSD under checked RN-even and gradual underflow; not a proof of arbitrary libm or all CPUs/errata.

sources.title: GCC 13 changes, C++ excess precision
sources.readScope: C++ section: excess-precision support introduced for C++; strict standard and GNU modes have different defaults. New candidate profile uses explicit standard precision and SSE2, pending actual GNU command/instruction audit.

reuse: No external implementation, document image/table/body text or font copied. Original engine code, independent mathematical checker and original SVG. No new runtime library, payment, paid contract, forum or email operation. Engine license remains undecided.
limitation: Specification reading and requested compiler configuration do not establish that the actual object/linked caller implements the intended operation graph. That requires separate fail-closed artifact and command provenance checks.
